currentUserGoal: Make the shop/store easier to unlock.
changesMade: Added a Store access helper that unlocks the Store at 120 lifetime Grass Touches, after collecting 1 lifetime gold, or through the previous Sprinkler Calibration route for existing saves.
Changed the Store button gate to use the new Store access helper instead of requiring Sprinkler Calibration level 1.
Changed Sprinkler Route automation to unlock with Store access so the newly available Store has a useful first automation purchase immediately.
Updated the locked Store message to describe the new unlock path.
Updated the game systems reference where it still said Sprinkler Calibration level 1 opened the Store.
verification: git diff --check passed with only normal Windows LF-to-CRLF warnings.

untrackedLeftAlone: docs/Strategieen voor Geavanceerde Automatisering in Incrementele Games.md

knownIssues: This is a balance tweak, not a full early-game playthrough. Watch whether 120 lifetime touches makes passive automation arrive too quickly.
The legacy helper name hasTinySprinklerStoreUnlock still refers to Sprinkler Calibration ownership, because it is still used by the upgrade data.
nextRecommendedSteps: Deploy and sync the change if the earlier Store unlock feels right.
If early automation feels too fast, keep Store access early but raise Sprinkler Route cost or require 1 lifetime gold for automation purchases.
doNotRevert: Keep Store access separate from the old Sprinkler Calibration-only gate unless intentionally restoring slower early-game pacing.
